0022600005.text: Both teams open the 2026-27 season in this regular-season game, with the Golden State Warriors on the road at the Los Angeles Lakers. The Warriors are missing Brandin Podziemski (back, soreness), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Charles Bassey (knee) and Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf) is day-to-day with a game-time decision. Golden State lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 119-103 loss to Los Angeles in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
